label: The preferred generic name is zanubrutinib.
Zanubrutinib is marketed under the brand name BRUKINSA.
BRUKINSA is associated with FDA application NDA 213217.
The ALPINE study is registered as NCT03734016.
The ALPINE interim analysis is available as PMC9928683.
The ALPINE China subgroup analysis is available as PMC11512864.
The recommended dosage of BRUKINSA is 160 mg orally twice daily or 320 mg orally once daily.
